full_judgment: 18. No doubt, government always deserves getting a lenient view only because it is presumed by the court that the governments acts to secure public interest, to secure public properties and to do public good, not because it is above the law or is entitled to get any biased treatment from the court of law, even if by wasting public money. However, having read the judgments of the courts below, I find no basis to draw such a presumption in this case.
